description: This file defines encoding modes for CBOR serialization within the Kubernetes project, including configurations for deterministic encoding, handling of special data types, and custom marshaling behavior.

classes.name: EncMode
classes.description: EncMode encapsulates a CBOR encoding mode with methods for options retrieval and marshaling.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Returns encoding options for the EncMode.

methods.name: MarshalTo
methods.description: Serializes a value to an io.Writer using the EncMode.

methods.name: Marshal
methods.description: Serializes a value to a byte slice using the EncMode.
